bull_bear.body:
- Proprietary, patent-protected technology: a patent relating to the ZeroTouch Question Paper Delivery System was granted on 28 April 2026 (described in the MD's message as a 20-year patent for ZEROTOUCH DaaS), which management says strengthens its IP portfolio and competitive positioning in secure examination management
- Diversified portfolio spanning Education ERP, Industrial ERP, Examination Management, SaaS and ITES, reducing dependence on any single vertical
- Recurring-revenue base from SaaS subscriptions, annual maintenance contracts and managed services, which the Company says supports business stability, customer retention and long-term revenue visibility
- Long operating record and institutional footprint — 18 years in business, engaged in projects with 55+ universities, presence across 06 states, collaborations across 11 industries and 07 tenders awarded during the year
- NEP-aligned ERP with embedded AI capabilities, positioning products against evolving Indian education-policy and digital-governance requirements
- Government and institutional order wins during the year, including a Rs. 10.97 crore work order from the Government of Gujarat and a Rs. 1.45 crore annual contract from Barkatullah University
- Founder-led management with long domain tenure (Managing Director with over 16-17 years in the IT sector, associated with the Company since incorporation)
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Technology obsolescence — Rapid technological advancement may impact product relevance and competitiveness, and continuous change may require substantial investment in product development, innovation and upgradation of existing solutions. Named as the first row of the Company's Enterprise Risk Management framework; mitigation is continuous product enhancement, R&D and adoption of emerging technologies.
- Cybersecurity and information-security failure — Cyber threats, data breaches and system vulnerabilities may affect business continuity and customer confidence. Structural for a company whose core products carry examination papers and institutional student data; the Board's risk-management note lists cyber security threats, data protection and information security among the risks it continuously evaluates.
- Intense competition and pricing pressure — The software and IT services industry is highly competitive with domestic and international players offering similar products; management states competition may impact pricing, market share and profitability, and lists 'pricing pressure' from growing competition and changing customer expectations as a separate threat to margins.
- Dependence on institutional, enterprise and government spending cycles — Delays in technology spending, procurement cycles or budgetary constraints among educational institutions and enterprises may affect business growth; the ERM framework separately flags 'Customer Procurement & Revenue Cycle' — delays in procurement approvals and decision-making may impact project execution and revenue realization. Compounded by the concentration of the order book in government and university tenders (e.g. Government of Gujarat and Barkatullah University orders) and only 07 tenders awarded during the year.
- Client / related-party concentration — The Board's risk-management note explicitly lists 'client dependency' among the risks continuously evaluated. Separately, the shareholder notice seeks approval for related-party transactions with associate Infinity Transoft Solution Private Limited (49.42% held) whose proposed limit equals 63.10% of the Company's audited consolidated annual turnover for FY 2025-26 — a very large share of activity routed through a single related counterparty, even though it is stated to be in the ordinary course and at arm's length.
- Talent acquisition and retention — The technology sector faces intense competition for skilled professionals, which may impact retention and increase employee costs; the ERM framework flags that challenges in attracting and retaining skilled professionals may affect growth and service delivery. Reported employee attrition was 16.55% and employee benefit expenses rose in line with business expansion.
- Regulatory and compliance change — Changes in laws, regulations, data-protection requirements and industry standards may increase compliance obligations and operational costs. Elevated by the Company's move from an unlisted public company to a listed entity on the SME Platform of BSE on 08 October 2025, which brings the SEBI Listing Regulations regime.
- Macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainty — Macroeconomic challenges, inflationary pressures and geopolitical developments may influence customer spending patterns and investment decisions — relevant given the discretionary, project-led nature of ERP and examination-technology purchases.
- Disruption from AI-driven change in the business environment — The Board states it monitors emerging risks associated with evolving digital technologies and Artificial Intelligence-driven business environments which may impact business processes, service delivery and market dynamics — a genuine two-sided exposure for a company whose differentiation rests on proprietary ERP and examination software.
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

business.body: Infinity Infoway Limited is engaged in software development, ERP solutions, examination management systems, SaaS platforms and IT-enabled services. It provides Artificial Intelligence-based integrated Enterprise Resource Planning solutions across education, manufacturing, corporate and retail sectors, and serves educational institutions, enterprises and government-related organisations with technology-driven solutions designed to improve operational efficiency, governance and digital transformation. Alongside its ERP offerings it runs an Online Examination System, the proprietary ZEROTOUCH secure question-paper delivery platform and the Brainzorg self-learning platform, plus implementation, maintenance, managed services, cloud deployment and technical consulting.
business.title: What they do

business.body:
- **Education ERP Solutions:** NEP (National Education Policy)-enabled ERP, Integrated digital campus management platform (admissions, academics, examinations, finance, HR, communication, compliance)
- **Industrial ERP Solutions:** Industrial/enterprise ERP (finance, inventory, procurement, production planning, CRM, HR administration)
- **Examination Management & Assessment:** Online Examination System (OES), ZEROTOUCH Question Paper Delivery System, ZEROTOUCH DaaS (Device as a Service)
- **SaaS & IT Enabled Services:** Subscription-based SaaS offerings, Annual maintenance contracts, managed services, cloud deployment, technical consulting
- **Digital Learning:** Brainzorg self-learning platform (digital courses for students and professionals)
business.title: Products & brands

business.body:
- Infinity Transoft Solution Private Limited (ITSPL) — associate: Associate company in which Infinity Infoway holds 49.42% of the equity share capital and exercises significant influence over financial and operating decisions. Managing Director Bhaveshkumar Dhirajlal Gadhethariya is also a director on ITSPL's board. Proposed related-party dealings cover rendering and availing software development, software consulting, ERP solutions, web and mobile application development, website development and hosting, IT-enabled services, technical support, project execution, data processing, manpower support services and reimbursement of expenses, in the ordinary course of business on an arm's length basis; shareholder approval for a material RPT with ITSPL was sought under Regulation 23 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.
- Germany subsidiary (unnamed in this bundle) — subsidiary: Historical only — the corporate journey timeline shows global expansion via a Germany subsidiary in the 2016-2018 phase and its closure as part of the 2021-2024 business restructuring. Form AOC-1 Part A confirms the Company has no subsidiary company as at the year end, and no subsidiary was liquidated or sold during the period.

outlook.body:
- Core business strategy 'Implementation of Zero Touch Technology': invest up to Rs. 375.00 lakhs in developing the proprietary ZEROTOUCH DaaS to secure examination papers against leakage during preparation, printing and distribution.
- Expansion roadmap: expand sales and service offices, and in the coming year expand geographic reach both within India and into international markets (marketing activities outside India already initiated).
- Expand Education ERP deployment across schools, colleges, universities, coaching institutions and educational groups through integrated digital campus management solutions, targeting higher customer acquisition and recurring revenue.
- Strengthen Industrial ERP offerings with automation, workflow intelligence, analytics and industry-specific functionality to penetrate manufacturing, service and trading enterprises.
- Scale the ZeroTouch Question Paper Delivery System across educational boards, universities, colleges and examination authorities to build market presence in secure examination infrastructure.
- Grow SaaS and managed services — subscription-based solutions, cloud hosting and annual maintenance contracts — to improve revenue visibility, customer retention and recurring income.
- Invest in AI, cloud and emerging technologies: integrate artificial intelligence, machine learning, predictive analytics and cloud into products and services for differentiation and operating efficiency.
- Strengthen cybersecurity and digital trust frameworks — information security infrastructure, compliance standards and data protection mechanisms.
- Continuous product innovation to enhance functionality, usability, mobile accessibility, integration capability and customer experience.
- Transition into a scalable, innovation-led and government-focused SaaS platform, treating Artificial Intelligence as an opportunity and leveraging it to enhance product capabilities, operational efficiency and productivity.
- Retain and engage talent through ESOP schemes for top performers, recognition programmes and employee engagement initiatives (stated attrition of 16.55%).
- Multi-channel sales and marketing strategy across outbound, offline, content, email and social media marketing, with demos, events and client visits.
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: Infinity Infoway is asset-light: the Directors' Report states that the Company does not hold any specific capital expenditure programme and that capital expenditure is undertaken based on operational requirements, business expansion plans and technological development needs, approved by the Board from time to time. During FY 2025-26 the Company made investments in capital assets aggregating to Rs. 901.24 Lakhs, comprising Tangible Assets of Rs. 692.98 Lakhs and Intangible Assets of Rs. 208.26 Lakhs, made primarily towards strengthening infrastructure, operational capabilities and long-term business growth. The main build-out is the proprietary ZEROTOUCH DaaS (Device as a Service) secure examination-paper printing and delivery platform: under 'Core Business Strategies' the Company states it plans to invest up to Rs. 375.00 lakhs in developing ZEROTOUCH DaaS to secure examination papers against leakage during preparation, printing and distribution, and this was also the first named object of the IPO. The Company listed on the SME Platform of BSE on 08 October 2025 and raised Rs. 2,200.86 Lacs, of which Rs. 1,109.27 Lakhs had been utilised and Rs. 1,091.59 Lakhs remained unutilised as on 31 March 2026 (temporarily parked in scheduled bank accounts, to be applied to the stated objects: ZEROTOUCH DaaS development, purchase of new IT infrastructure, funding of tender deposits and EMD, incremental working capital, and general corporate purposes). Forward expansion is capacity of deployment rather than plant: the Managing Director states ZEROTOUCH will be a key growth driver with planned deployment of over 150 machines reaching more than 6.4 lakh students across universities and 204 institutions, expected to contribute 20-22% of total revenue. Alongside this the Company's stated Expansion Roadmap is to expand its sales and service offices, and in the coming year to expand geographic reach both within India and into international markets, with marketing activities outside India already initiated. During the year the Company launched the AI-enabled ZeroTouch DaaS platform (disclosed to BSE), and a patent relating to the ZeroTouch Question Paper Delivery System was granted subsequent to year-end on 28 April 2026. No manufacturing plant, capacity addition, commissioning or debottlenecking programme is disclosed anywhere in this bundle.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Gartner: worldwide IT spending expected to reach approximately USD 6.15 trillion in 2026, growth of ~10.8%; software spending projected to grow 14.7% and IT services spending 8.7% — sustained demand for enterprise applications and digital transformation.
- Gartner: India's IT spending expected to exceed USD 176 billion in 2026, growth of ~10.6%, with software spending +17.6% and IT services +11.1%; NASSCOM estimates the Indian technology industry crossed USD 300 billion in FY 2025-26.
- Global EdTech market projected to grow at ~15.4% CAGR to USD 299.7 billion by 2028; India's edtech market poised to reach a USD 10 billion economy — driven by digital learning infrastructure, cloud education platforms, AI and learning analytics.
- Indian ERP software market projected to grow from ~USD 0.71 billion in 2024 to USD 1.04 billion by 2028 at ~10.01% CAGR, supported by cloud investment, process automation, AI and enterprise modernization; cloud-based ERP gaining traction in India especially among SMEs for cost efficiency, flexibility and scalability.
- Educational institutions are increasingly adopting digital campus management, online examination platforms, automated administration and integrated student lifecycle management — management expects sustained demand for the Company's Education ERP platform.
- Enterprises across manufacturing, services and trading are investing in ERP modernization and process automation, supporting demand for the Company's Industrial ERP solutions.
- Rising emphasis on examination integrity, confidentiality, transparency and secure digital examination infrastructure by institutions and examination authorities — management expects significant growth opportunities for the ZeroTouch Question Paper Delivery System.
- Increasing customer preference for subscription-based and cloud-enabled solutions is expected to strengthen recurring revenue streams, improve customer retention and enhance long-term business visibility.
- Government-led digital initiatives — Digital India, educational modernization programmes, NEP alignment and technology-enabled governance — continue to support adoption of digital platforms and enterprise software.
- Rising organisational spend on cybersecurity and data protection creates demand for secure and compliant software platforms; the Company's continuous cybersecurity investment is expected to enhance customer confidence.
- Growing adoption of AI, workflow automation and data analytics presents opportunities for product enhancement and next-generation solutions; management explicitly frames AI as an opportunity rather than a disruption to its business model.
- Expanding demand for implementation, maintenance, managed services, cloud deployment and technical support underpins growth of the ITES vertical.
- Watch-items on the demand side: delays in technology spending, procurement cycles or budgetary constraints among educational institutions and enterprises; pricing pressure from competition; and macroeconomic/inflationary/geopolitical influences on customer spending patterns.
- 07 tenders awarded during the year (stated in the 'Key Facts' spread).
- Rs. 10.97 crore work order from the Government of Gujarat secured during the year (MD's message and corporate journey timeline).
- Rs. 1.45 crore annual contract from Barkatullah University, Bhopal (MD's message; shown as a university contract in the journey timeline).
- Government of Madhya Pradesh education project with a Rs. 7.15 crore ERP order, shown in the 2025 'inflection year' milestone of the corporate journey.
- Strategic integration with Timepay to expand into fintech-enabled ERP solutions.
- Engaged in projects with 55+ universities; presence across 06 states and collaborations across 11 industries.

one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: Infinity Infoway is a Rajkot-based SaaS company providing AI-enabled, NEP-aligned integrated ERP, online examination and secure question-paper delivery platforms to educational institutions, enterprises and government bodies, with projects across 55+ universities.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Infinity Infoway Limited is engaged in software development, ERP solutions, examination management systems, SaaS platforms and IT-enabled services. It provides Artificial Intelligence-based integrated Enterprise Resource Planning solutions across education, manufacturing, corporate and retail sectors, and serves educational institutions, enterprises and government-related organisations with technology-driven solutions designed to improve operational efficiency, governance and digital transformation. Alongside its ERP offerings it runs an Online Examination System, the proprietary ZEROTOUCH secure question-paper delivery platform and the Brainzorg self-learning platform, plus implementation, maintenance, managed services, cloud deployment and technical consulting.

group_structure.title: Group structure (subsidiaries / JV / related parties)
group_structure.body:
- Infinity Transoft Solution Private Limited (ITSPL) — associate: Associate company in which Infinity Infoway holds 49.42% of the equity share capital and exercises significant influence over financial and operating decisions. Managing Director Bhaveshkumar Dhirajlal Gadhethariya is also a director on ITSPL's board. Proposed related-party dealings cover rendering and availing software development, software consulting, ERP solutions, web and mobile application development, website development and hosting, IT-enabled services, technical support, project execution, data processing, manpower support services and reimbursement of expenses, in the ordinary course of business on an arm's length basis; shareholder approval for a material RPT with ITSPL was sought under Regulation 23 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.
- Germany subsidiary (unnamed in this bundle) — subsidiary: Historical only — the corporate journey timeline shows global expansion via a Germany subsidiary in the 2016-2018 phase and its closure as part of the 2021-2024 business restructuring. Form AOC-1 Part A confirms the Company has no subsidiary company as at the year end, and no subsidiary was liquidated or sold during the period.

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Education ERP Solutions:** NEP (National Education Policy)-enabled ERP, Integrated digital campus management platform (admissions, academics, examinations, finance, HR, communication, compliance)
- **Industrial ERP Solutions:** Industrial/enterprise ERP (finance, inventory, procurement, production planning, CRM, HR administration)
- **Examination Management & Assessment:** Online Examination System (OES), ZEROTOUCH Question Paper Delivery System, ZEROTOUCH DaaS (Device as a Service)
- **SaaS & IT Enabled Services:** Subscription-based SaaS offerings, Annual maintenance contracts, managed services, cloud deployment, technical consulting
- **Digital Learning:** Brainzorg self-learning platform (digital courses for students and professionals)

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- Educational institutions — schools, colleges, universities, coaching institutions and educational groups
- Examination boards and examination-conducting authorities
- Government and government-related organisations (e.g. Government of Gujarat work order; earlier Government of MP education project)
- Enterprises in manufacturing, services, trading and retail sectors
- India — presence across 06 states; marketing activities initiated outside India with planned expansion into international markets

certifications.title: Certs (RHP)
certifications.body: ISO 27001:2022 (information security management) — shown as a certification badge on the Infinity ERP corporate-overview spread; no certifying body or scope is stated in the text

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Gartner: worldwide IT spending expected to reach approximately USD 6.15 trillion in 2026, growth of ~10.8%; software spending projected to grow 14.7% and IT services spending 8.7% — sustained demand for enterprise applications and digital transformation.
- Gartner: India's IT spending expected to exceed USD 176 billion in 2026, growth of ~10.6%, with software spending +17.6% and IT services +11.1%; NASSCOM estimates the Indian technology industry crossed USD 300 billion in FY 2025-26.
- Global EdTech market projected to grow at ~15.4% CAGR to USD 299.7 billion by 2028; India's edtech market poised to reach a USD 10 billion economy — driven by digital learning infrastructure, cloud education platforms, AI and learning analytics.
- Indian ERP software market projected to grow from ~USD 0.71 billion in 2024 to USD 1.04 billion by 2028 at ~10.01% CAGR, supported by cloud investment, process automation, AI and enterprise modernization; cloud-based ERP gaining traction in India especially among SMEs for cost efficiency, flexibility and scalability.
- Educational institutions are increasingly adopting digital campus management, online examination platforms, automated administration and integrated student lifecycle management — management expects sustained demand for the Company's Education ERP platform.
- Enterprises across manufacturing, services and trading are investing in ERP modernization and process automation, supporting demand for the Company's Industrial ERP solutions.
- Rising emphasis on examination integrity, confidentiality, transparency and secure digital examination infrastructure by institutions and examination authorities — management expects significant growth opportunities for the ZeroTouch Question Paper Delivery System.
- Increasing customer preference for subscription-based and cloud-enabled solutions is expected to strengthen recurring revenue streams, improve customer retention and enhance long-term business visibility.
- Government-led digital initiatives — Digital India, educational modernization programmes, NEP alignment and technology-enabled governance — continue to support adoption of digital platforms and enterprise software.
- Rising organisational spend on cybersecurity and data protection creates demand for secure and compliant software platforms; the Company's continuous cybersecurity investment is expected to enhance customer confidence.
- Growing adoption of AI, workflow automation and data analytics presents opportunities for product enhancement and next-generation solutions; management explicitly frames AI as an opportunity rather than a disruption to its business model.
- Expanding demand for implementation, maintenance, managed services, cloud deployment and technical support underpins growth of the ITES vertical.
- Watch-items on the demand side: delays in technology spending, procurement cycles or budgetary constraints among educational institutions and enterprises; pricing pressure from competition; and macroeconomic/inflationary/geopolitical influences on customer spending patterns.
- 07 tenders awarded during the year (stated in the 'Key Facts' spread).
- Rs. 10.97 crore work order from the Government of Gujarat secured during the year (MD's message and corporate journey timeline).
- Rs. 1.45 crore annual contract from Barkatullah University, Bhopal (MD's message; shown as a university contract in the journey timeline).
- Government of Madhya Pradesh education project with a Rs. 7.15 crore ERP order, shown in the 2025 'inflection year' milestone of the corporate journey.
- Strategic integration with Timepay to expand into fintech-enabled ERP solutions.
- Engaged in projects with 55+ universities; presence across 06 states and collaborations across 11 industries.

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Core business strategy 'Implementation of Zero Touch Technology': invest up to Rs. 375.00 lakhs in developing the proprietary ZEROTOUCH DaaS to secure examination papers against leakage during preparation, printing and distribution.
- Expansion roadmap: expand sales and service offices, and in the coming year expand geographic reach both within India and into international markets (marketing activities outside India already initiated).
- Expand Education ERP deployment across schools, colleges, universities, coaching institutions and educational groups through integrated digital campus management solutions, targeting higher customer acquisition and recurring revenue.
- Strengthen Industrial ERP offerings with automation, workflow intelligence, analytics and industry-specific functionality to penetrate manufacturing, service and trading enterprises.
- Scale the ZeroTouch Question Paper Delivery System across educational boards, universities, colleges and examination authorities to build market presence in secure examination infrastructure.
- Grow SaaS and managed services — subscription-based solutions, cloud hosting and annual maintenance contracts — to improve revenue visibility, customer retention and recurring income.
- Invest in AI, cloud and emerging technologies: integrate artificial intelligence, machine learning, predictive analytics and cloud into products and services for differentiation and operating efficiency.
- Strengthen cybersecurity and digital trust frameworks — information security infrastructure, compliance standards and data protection mechanisms.
- Continuous product innovation to enhance functionality, usability, mobile accessibility, integration capability and customer experience.
- Transition into a scalable, innovation-led and government-focused SaaS platform, treating Artificial Intelligence as an opportunity and leveraging it to enhance product capabilities, operational efficiency and productivity.
- Retain and engage talent through ESOP schemes for top performers, recognition programmes and employee engagement initiatives (stated attrition of 16.55%).
- Multi-channel sales and marketing strategy across outbound, offline, content, email and social media marketing, with demos, events and client visits.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Proprietary, patent-protected technology: a patent relating to the ZeroTouch Question Paper Delivery System was granted on 28 April 2026 (described in the MD's message as a 20-year patent for ZEROTOUCH DaaS), which management says strengthens its IP portfolio and competitive positioning in secure examination management

- Recurring-revenue base from SaaS subscriptions, annual maintenance contracts and managed services, which the Company says supports business stability, customer retention and long-term revenue visibility
- Long operating record and institutional footprint — 18 years in business, engaged in projects with 55+ universities, presence across 06 states, collaborations across 11 industries and 07 tenders awarded during the year

- Government and institutional order wins during the year, including a Rs. 10.97 crore work order from the Government of Gujarat and a Rs. 1.45 crore annual contract from Barkatullah University
- Founder-led management with long domain tenure (Managing Director with over 16-17 years in the IT sector, associated with the Company since incorporation)
